text: {"observations":"I could not hear the audio, so this is an estimate from the clip length only. At a typical reading rate of about 2.5-3 words per second, a 14.7 s utterance holds roughly 35-40 words, and under dictionary-style stress marking most words (including many function words) carry a stressed phoneme. That favours thirty-two (B); three (A) is far too few for this length, and eleven (D) or fifteen (C) would imply unusually slow or sparse speech.","answer":"B"}
